messages:
Ivy Park: Heads up  hit a confusing failure in the Java quickstart. README shows `System.getenv(\"REDWOOD_KEY\")` but the SDK now expects `REDWOOD_API_KEY`. New devs get 401 when they copy/paste. Also the Maven artifact in the example is `com.redwood:client` but the real artifact is `com.redwood:inference-client`.

Samir Gupta: Oof. I ran the sample-app and it also uses the older blocking API but the snippet shows `CompletableFuture` usage. So people try the async snippet without configuring the executor and see `NoClassDefFoundError` on `CompletableFuture` helper classes in older JDKs.

Ria Desai: Reproduced locally. There's also a CLI example in the quickstart using `redwood --key <key> generate` but the CLI flag changed to `--api-key` last release. So between the env var, Maven coordinates and CLI flag, the first-run experience is rough.

Ivy Park: Can we standardize to `REDWOOD_API_KEY` in all language quickstarts and show the maven/gradle artifact names that match the current package? Also update the CLI examples to the new flag.

Samir Gupta: I'd add a one-line troubleshooting section: 401 -> verify env var name and header format `Authorization: Bearer <key>`; 403 -> token scope (gen vs embed). Also call out JDK compatibility for the async examples.

Ria Desai: I'll prepare a small PR. Plan: 1) change env var to `REDWOOD_API_KEY` in README and curl/CLI snippets, 2) update Maven/Gradle coordinates to `com.redwood:inference-client:1.4.0`, 3) provide both blocking and async Java snippets with `CompletableFuture` note and JDK requirement, 4) update CLI flag to `--api-key`, 5) remove manual retry wrappers in the sample-app (SDK handles retries), and add a short note about opting out: `new Client(apiKey, ClientOptions.builder().maxRetries(0).build())`.

Ivy Park: Nice. Can you include a tiny Gradle snippet and a curl example showing the correct header?

Ria Desai: Draft snippets: Java blocking:
```java
String key = System.getenv(\"REDWOOD_API_KEY\");
Client client = Client.builder().apiKey(key).build();
Response r = client.generate(\"Write a two-line poem about caches\");
System.out.println(r.getText());
```
Java async note: \"For async usage we show CompletableFuture-based calls; requires JDK 11+. Use `client.generateAsync(...)` and handle the future.\"

curl example:
```
curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY\" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'
```
Gradle example:
```
implementation 'com.redwood:inference-client:1.4.0'
```

Samir Gupta: LGTM. Leave a tiny nit on wording for the JDK callout. Add a CI snippet test that runs the curl/CLI examples with a fake key to validate quoting/flags.

Ria Desai: PR opened: https://git.redwood/docs/pull/4218 includes env var parity, Maven/Gradle coord updates, blocking+async java snippets, CLI flag fix, removal of manual retry wrapper, and troubleshooting notes. Requesting review.

docs-bot: docs-bot: Added label `DX` and requested reviewers: @ivy, @samir.

Samir Gupta: Reviewed and approved after a small wording tweak on the JDK note.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: docs site updated: https://docs.redwood.ai/java-quickstart version 2026-03-26T10:22Z :rocket:

Ria Desai: Closing thread. I'll run a grep across the repo for old CLI flags and artifact coordinates next sprint and open follow-ups if needed. Thanks! :tada:
